lines.text: The LORD sends Samuel to Jesse of Bethlehem to anoint a king, and tells him to take a heifer.
The elders of Bethlehem tremble and ask Samuel if he comes in peace, and he consecrates Jesse and his sons.
Samuel sees Eliab and thinks he is the anointed, but the LORD says He sees the strength.
Jesse presents Abinadab, Shammah and others, ten sons in all, but the youngest is tending the sheep.
The LORD tells Samuel to anoint the youngest son, and the Spirit of the LORD rushes upon David.
